inventory_and_capacity_rules.slot_capacity: Total seats per workshop session (1 to 100, constrained by ck_rbpc_slots_capacity_range)
inventory_and_capacity_rules.reserved_seats: Temporary holds with active reserve timeouts (ck_rbpc_slots_reserved_nonneg)
inventory_and_capacity_rules.capacity_invariant: Physical database constraint: reserved_seats + confirmed_seats <= capacity (ck_rbpc_slots_capacity_bound)

reserve_timeout_and_expiration.lazy_and_explicit_cleanup: Pending holds past expires_at automatically transition to 'expired', releasing reserved_seats back to available pool
reserve_timeout_and_expiration.no_false_checkouts: Expired holds reject confirmation attempts with HTTP 409 RESERVATION_EXPIRED

concurrency_race_condition_defense.negative_abuse_invariant: Two users cannot confirm or reserve the last remaining seat twice.
concurrency_race_condition_defense.pessimistic_locking: Transactions acquire row-level lock (with_for_update) on workshop slot and reservation rows, serializing concurrent allocations.
concurrency_race_condition_defense.database_check_constraint: PostgreSQL CheckConstraint ck_rbpc_slots_capacity_bound guarantees zero overbooking even across distributed worker threads.

endpoints.description: Retrieve workshop slots and real seat availability calendar for an experience
Temporarily hold seat capacity with countdown timeout and idempotency protection
Visitor status lookup with lazy expiration cleanup and remaining hold countdown
Partner confirmation moving seats from reserved to confirmed permanently with audit log
Partner or visitor cancellation restoring seat capacity back to available inventory
Partner endpoint to open a new calendar workshop slot with seat capacity
List workshop slots for experiences owned by authenticated partner

scenarios_covered: Query experience availability calendar returns correct slots and seat metrics
Reserving seats holds capacity with reserve timeout and returns reservation receipt
Idempotent reservation replay returns original receipt without double-holding seats
Differing payload with same idempotency key rejected with 409 RBPC_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
Attempting to reserve more seats than capacity rejected with 409 INSUFFICIENT_SEAT_CAPACITY
Expired holds automatically transition to expired and release seats back to available inventory
Partner confirmation transitions seats from reserved to confirmed and synchronizes linked inquiry
Partner confirmation of expired hold rejected with 409 RESERVATION_EXPIRED (no false checkout)
Cancelling reservation restores seat capacity back to available pool
Multi-tenant RBAC: guest forbidden (403), cross-tenant mutation rejected (403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE)
Negative abuse: Two concurrent worker threads attempting to reserve last seat on capacity=1 slot (exactly 1 succeeds, 1 rejected with 409)
Negative abuse: Two concurrent worker threads attempting to confirm the same reservation (zero overbooking, capacity strictly preserved)
